title: 被锁在外面了
setting: Hangzhou, a housing compound, 11:40 pm, minus two degrees.

guard.name: 保安师傅
guard.en: the night guard, watching a drama on his phone

auntie.name: 七楼阿姨
auntie.en: the auntie from the seventh floor

steps.narr: Door slammed. Keys and phone inside. You're outside, in pyjamas. 🥶
steps.zh: 风把门关上了，钥匙和手机都锁在屋里了。
年轻人，这么晚了，有什么事？

not.note: That says you're NOT locked out: 我被锁在外面了.

say.tip: 被锁在外面了 = got locked out. 进不去 = can't get in: a 不 in the middle (进不去, 吃不下) says you can't manage it.

mistakes.note: 了 goes at the very end: 我被锁在外面了.

ok.zh: 钥匙忘屋里了？你住哪栋？
ok.en: Left your keys inside? Which building are you in?

miss.zh: 钥匙锁屋里了吧？住哪栋的？
miss.en: Keys locked inside, right? Which building?

say.gloss: I live in Building Five, flat 802.
say.tip: 号楼 = building number. Flat numbers go digit by digit: 八零二 bā líng èr. A 1 in them is usually said yāo.

mistakes.note: Flat numbers go digit by digit: 八零二, not 八百零二.

ok.zh: 五号楼八零二……你拿什么证明你住这儿？
ok.en: Building Five, 802... and can you prove you live here?

miss.zh: 连自己住哪儿都说不清？
miss.en: Can't even say where you live?

steps.narr: Behind you, the auntie from the seventh floor is out walking her poodle. In a fur coat. 🐩
steps.zh: 七楼的阿姨正好出来遛狗。

say.en: Prove it: your address is on the takeaway slip.
answers: 你看，外卖单上有我的地址！
外卖单上写着我的地址。
你看这个，上面有我家地址。
say.gloss: Look, my address is on the takeaway slip!
say.tip: 证明 zhèngmíng = prove. 外卖单上 = on the takeaway slip: a thing becomes a place with 上 (on) after it.

mistakes.note: 地点 dìdiǎn is a place or venue. An address is 地址 dìzhǐ.

alts.en: Or: ask the seventh-floor auntie to vouch for you
alts.gloss: Auntie, you know me, don't you?

then.zh: 认识啊！八零二的，天天点外卖！
then.en: Course I do! 802. Orders takeaway every single day!

then.zh: 天天点外卖？单子给我看看。
then.en: Every day, eh? Let's see that slip.

ok.en: The takeaway slip? Give it here.

miss.zh: 证明不了？那我不能放你进去。
miss.en: Can't prove it? Then I can't let you in.
You spend the night in the guard booth, sharing your malatang with the guard. 🥡
miss.zh: 那一夜，你和保安在亭子里分了一碗麻辣烫。

say.en: Own it, with dignity: that's your username.

not.note: 不是我 denies it. Own it: 对，是我。

say.tip: 网名 wǎngmíng = online name, username. 别念了 = stop reading it out!

ok.zh: 哈哈哈！原来你就是“饿死了”！

fail.zh: 不是你？那这外卖是谁的？
fail.en: Not you? Then whose takeaway is this?

miss.en: Not admitting it? Fine. I get it, I get it.

steps.zh: 你上个月不是在我这里放了把备用钥匙吗？
steps.en: Didn't you leave a spare key with me last month?

say.en: He had your key all along. Ask why he didn't say so sooner!
say.gloss: Then why didn't you say so sooner?!
say.tip: 怎么不早说 = why didn't you say so sooner?: the cry of everyone who just did it the hard way.

alts.en: Or: thank him and offer him half your malatang
answers: 谢谢师傅！麻辣烫分您一半！
太谢谢了，请您吃麻辣烫！
alts.gloss: Thank you! Have half my malatang!

then.zh: 我不吃辣。快回去吧，别冻感冒了！
then.en: I don't do spicy. Get inside before you freeze!

fail.en: Take it! What are you standing there for?

miss.en: What, too slow for you, was I?

0.tip: 怎么不早说 = why didn't you say so sooner?

steps.en: Home at 11:58 pm. The malatang is cold. The username stays.
steps.zh: 十一点五十八，你终于进了家门。麻辣烫已经凉了。
